title: Real Estate Ads: 12 Examples and Ideas for Indian Projects
seoTitle: Real Estate Ads: 12 Examples & Ideas for India
excerpt: 12 real estate ad examples for Meta, Instagram and Google — walkthrough reels, location maps, price-band creatives and search ads — plus RERA rules to follow.

faqs.question: What makes a good real estate ad?
faqs.answer: It answers the buyer’s real questions — where, how much, how far and can I trust this builder — and ends with one clear action, like getting the price sheet on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do real estate ads need a RERA number?
faqs.answer: Ads for registered projects should carry the project’s RERA registration number, and the QR code where the state requires it. CPs should also add their RERA agent number.

faqs.question: Which video ads work best for property?
faqs.answer: A 30-second sample-flat walkthrough, a commute video from the nearest metro or expressway, monthly construction progress, and a salesperson inviting viewers for a site visit.

faqs.question: Should property ads show the price?
faqs.answer: Yes, at least a starting price or band. It filters out buyers outside your budget before they enquire.

faqs.question: What should a Google search ad for a project say?
faqs.answer: Match the search: the project name with configurations, price and “RERA registered”; the locality with nearby landmarks and possession year; or “ready to move” for inventory with OC.

faqs.question: Where should real estate ads send people?
faqs.answer: To a project landing page that repeats the ad’s promise, not to the homepage or a generic page.

faqs.question: What are common real estate ad mistakes?
faqs.answer: Renders only with no real site photos, “price on request”, ten amenities and nothing about location, one generic page for every ad, and judging ads on clicks instead of site visits.

faqs.question: How does Meta’s housing ad category affect creatives?
faqs.answer: If the Special Ad Category for housing applies, age, gender and precise location targeting are limited, so the creative has to do more of the work of reaching the right buyers.
